nodes.label: Rationale: trace_id/agent_id forwarding gap across LLMClient and answer_query
nodes.rationale: LLMClient._call()/.embeddings()/.reasoning_stream() never forwarded trace_id/agent_id/user_id/dept_id to the transport layer, so Langfuse minted its own random trace id instead of correlating with Fleet's spend_ledger.trace_id. This blocked the 'feedback lands in Langfuse' AC for 4.3, and the same gap existed one layer up in fleet_rag.query.service.answer_query() for 4.4's RAG chat path. Fixed by forwarding **meta from all LLMClient methods to Transport calls; verified live via Langfuse API 404 to 200 before/after.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: trace_id/agent_id forwarding gap across llmclient and answer_query

nodes.label: Rationale: KillSwitch bytes vs str Redis decoding bug
nodes.rationale: redis.asyncio.Redis.get() returns raw bytes unless decode_responses=True, so value == '1' was silently always False against the real client, meaning a paused agent would have kept running in production. Caught specifically because the AC required live proof, not mocks. Fixed at the source in _is_flag_set() to accept str | bytes | None.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: killswitch bytes vs str redis decoding bug

nodes.label: Rationale: Presidio TR recognizer false-positive on generic nouns
nodes.rationale: cs-help-center's pii_policy=redact false-positive-flagged generic Turkish nouns ('Kredi', 'Kartı') as [PERSON], silently stripping 'kredi kartı kabul ediyoruz' from RAG context. Per explicit user decision, not fixed in Sprint 4; eval assertion corrected instead and logged as a tracked Sprint-8 KVKK-lane improvement item.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: presidio tr recognizer false-positive on generic nouns

nodes.label: Rationale: React controlled-input DOM/state desync under next dev
nodes.rationale: Playwright's .fill() visibly set the DOM value but the Send button stayed disabled because React's state was never actually updated, root-caused to next dev's fast-refresh instrumentation. Running E2E against next build && next start instead resolved it with no source change; documented in playwright.config.ts.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: react controlled-input dom/state desync under next dev

nodes.label: Rationale: SQL generator markdown code-fence wrapping JSON
nodes.rationale: make eval AGENT=analytics failed 100% of cases on first live run because the model wrapped its required JSON response in a markdown code fence despite the system prompt saying not to. Fixed with a _strip_code_fence() helper plus a prompt tweak; unit tests alone never would have found this since the fake LLM always returned bare JSON.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: sql generator markdown code-fence wrapping json

nodes.label: Rationale: GitHub 422 no-commits-between-branches on open_pr
nodes.rationale: create_branch only points a new ref at the base branch's existing commit; a PR against a branch with zero new commits is structurally rejected by GitHub. Fixed by adding github.commit_file (write:internal) called right after create_branch, matching the Dev Agent's own task wording.

nodes.label: Rationale: deterministic branch_suffix collision on repeated runs
nodes.rationale: The LLM's branch_suffix is near-deterministic for the same ticket wording, so repeated runs collided with their own prior branch on the persistent sandbox repo (GitHub 422 'Reference already exists'). Fixed by suffixing every branch name with a run-unique uuid4().hex[:8] token.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: deterministic branch_suffix collision on repeated runs

nodes.label: TRD §13.4 Per-agent eval threshold policy
nodes.rationale: make eval AGENT=x fails (exit 1) if the agent's pass rate is below its threshold; CI blocks agent-affecting PRs the same way. All three agents (support_copilot, analytics, dev_agent) are set to a 0.90 threshold.
